description: Check the tool definitions your client received from an MCP server against Glimind's signed transparency log of every server's tool list. Returns whether they match what the server currently advertises, an earlier recorded version, or nothing ever recorded — with a diff of added/removed/changed tools, a tool-poisoning scan, and a Merkle inclusion proof. Use it before trusting a server's tools, especially after they change.

serverId.description: The server's id in Glimind, if known (e.g. 'mcp-registry/io.github.github/github-mcp-server').

tools.description: The tools array exactly as tools/list returned it.

name: verify_tools
